questions.question: What is the difference between a raw material and a manufactured material? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A raw material comes from nature and has not been changed much by people, for example sand, clay, wood, wool or hide. A manufactured material is made by people from raw materials, for example glass, ceramics, plastic, paper, fabric or leather.

questions.question: Match each manufactured material to its raw material: glass, ceramics, plastic, paper, wool fabric, leather.
questions.expected_answer: Glass from sand; ceramics from clay; plastic from oil and coal; paper from wood; wool fabric from sheep's wool; leather from hide.

questions.question: Describe how clay is made into a ceramic mug.
questions.expected_answer: The soft, wet clay is shaped by hand or on a potter's wheel, dried, and then baked or fired at a very high temperature in a kiln. Firing makes it hard so that it will not soften in water again.
